project.name: host/host-parent
project.description: Parent of the host-space modules — the counterpart of osgi/bundle-parent. It will carry what is specific to actualisation-over-Pulumi adapters and NOT shared with the OSGi space (shade for the exec jar, exec-maven-plugin, com.pulumi/incus dependency management). Empty for now ON PURPOSE: no host module has migrated here yet (the roster lands in later slices). It exists so the next slice that moves a host module inherits a ready parent and is forced to refine it, rather than having to remember to create it.
